findings.title: Link checks use Playwright APIRequestContext, which bypasses the beta SSRF guard and DNS pinning
findings.recommendation: On RUNNER_BETA=1, a crawled site's off-site link (nav.to, expand.ts:177) to a private address, or a redirect or DNS rebind to one, is requested from Node without the context.route guard or the --host-resolver-rules pinning, and the status or error is shown in the report (blind SSRF with a status oracle). Send checkLink through makeOutboundFetch (pinned, every hop re-checked, guard-aware), as BE-101 did for contextFetcher.

resolution.note: BE-104: link and checker requests go through makeCheckerFetch/makeOutboundFetch; verified

findings.title: DEC-004 implemented as 'no key = every caller is owner', not 'local request = owner'
findings.recommendation: Safety rests only on cli.ts refusing a non-loopback bind. A user's own tunnel to localhost, or an embedder of RunnerServer, makes remote callers the owner. When no access key is set, also require a loopback req.socket.remoteAddress in carriesAccessKey/authorizeRoute.

resolution.note: BE-102 correction verified: loopback-only owner without key (DEC-004); Helper dispatch wiring incl. id-less view rows

findings.title: PDF Chromium launched with --no-sandbox while printing untrusted page text and AI output
findings.recommendation: JS off, offline mode and data:-only requests reduce the risk, but a renderer bug would not be contained. Keep the Chromium sandbox where the platform allows it, or isolate printing in a low-privilege process.

findings.title: Shared Link HTML (preview.html) will be served on the runner origin that holds the access cookie
findings.recommendation: When /s/:linkId is built, serve stored HTML with 'Content-Security-Policy: sandbox; default-src 'none'' and nosniff (or from a separate origin) so stored page or AI text can't script against /api with the owner's cookie.

findings.title: Encrypted key fallback: legacy plaintext may persist, and an undecryptable file is overwritten
findings.recommendation: Tell users to rotate keys once a plaintext .qa-keys.json is migrated (OneDrive or backups may keep old copies). Refuse to overwrite a file that can't be decrypted (wrong or missing QA_KEYS_ENCRYPTION_KEY) instead of silently dropping its other keys.

findings.title: Route dispatch: exact matching, validated params, closed by default; unmatched paths still gated
findings.recommendation: Add a test asserting that every allRoutes row declares access and beta, and that 'public' rows stay limited to /s/:linkId.

findings.title: isPublicAddress treats 192.0.0.0/24 and 198.18.0.0/15 as public (not changed by this workflow)
findings.recommendation: Consider classifying the IETF special-purpose and benchmarking ranges as non-public.

findings.title: Helper grants store the plaintext email address (third-party personal data, ADR 0036)
findings.recommendation: Make sure retention and deleteAudit cover grant.json, and keep emails out of logs.

findings.title: resolveShare returns the full AuditSummary for the public route
findings.recommendation: The future /s/:linkId handler must render only the shared snapshot and never serialize the summary to the client.

findings.title: Gemini API key is put in the request URL (not changed by this workflow)
findings.recommendation: Use the x-goog-api-key header so the key can't appear in proxy logs or error URLs.

findings.title: No XSS sinks in the wizard audit screens; HTML/DOCX/ZIP outputs escaped or sanitized
findings.recommendation: Keep img src limited to the base64 data-URI check in isEmbeddableImage.

findings.title: Hindi documents mix Hindi labels with English per-builder wording
findings.recommendation: labelsFor('hi') returns the Hindi table, but the wording tables only have en/ta and fall back to English (structure.ts:77, content.ts:121, findings.ts:48, pitch.ts:61, owner-audit.ts:63, roadmap-document.ts:42, proposal.ts:52, settings.ts:58). Language 'hi' gives a document marked 'hi' with Hindi headings and English body, Proposal and opt-out text. Add hi entries or move this wording into DocumentLabels so the type enforces it; until then report a fallback for hi; add a builder test that renders hi.

resolution.note: DEC-005: Hindi documents render English with beta note; verified by QA-711 23/23

findings.title: betaLabel is never used; beta-language documents carry no 'Beta translation' label (Q-45)
findings.recommendation: Add a note block from betaLabel(doc.language) in each builder or renderer, and test it for hi.

findings.title: Page language detection has no Devanagari; the wizard keeps a separate, different script table
findings.recommendation: Add Devanagari to SCRIPT_TABLE (the fixture hi/index.html currently reads as not-identified) and share one script table with packages/wizard/src/screens/audit/results/analysis-text.ts:129.

findings.title: Wizard copies values from @qa/types/@qa/core instead of importing them through browser.js
findings.recommendation: Export AUDIT_AI_STAGES, AUDIT_AI_API, STAGE_MODEL_SLOT, PROPOSAL_PLACEHOLDERS (move it into types) and the crawl limit bounds from packages/types/src/browser.ts; delete the copies (stage-models-api.ts:15-42, settings-api.ts:33, audit-start-form.ts:30-38) and their comparison tests, including the regex one.

findings.title: Wizard and the Structure document use different link-region order and labels
findings.recommendation: Wizard order is menu, footer, breadcrumb, internal; structure.ts:85 is menu, breadcrumb, footer, internal. Labels also differ (Breadcrumb/Breadcrumbs, Internal link/Links in the page content, two placedBy labels). Share one English label set and order through browser.js.

findings.title: Broken-link fetch contract allows following redirects into Skipped Pages
findings.recommendation: checkLinks checks only the first address against Skipped Pages. The comments say makeOutboundFetch (5 redirects by default) and the crawl's siteFetch also follows 5 (crawl.ts:142-148). Require makeCheckerFetch() with its default of 0 redirects (3xx returned as the response), say so in AnalysisInput.fetch and broken-links.ts:9,23, and test a redirect into a skipped area.

findings.title: requestSignal never clears its timer or abort listener after success
findings.recommendation: Return a cleanup, or clearTimeout and remove the listener in a finally in each provider's complete(); otherwise listeners pile up on a long-lived caller signal shared by many AI calls.

findings.title: HelperPermission redeclared in the runner
findings.recommendation: Import HelperPermission from @qa/types (website-audit.ts:864) instead of redeclaring it.

findings.title: Outbound pacer covers the first-hop host only
findings.recommendation: Redirect hops to the www twin or another host are not paced; pace per hop inside safeGet or document the limit.

findings.title: RunnerServer treats port 0 as 3001 (`options.port || 3001`)
findings.recommendation: Use `options.port ?? 3001` and return the bound port from start(); auth-crawl-run.test.ts and test-cap-endpoints.test.ts pass port: 0 and likely bind 3001.

findings.title: A stopped run may keep executing tests after stop (not confirmed)
findings.recommendation: After a failed pause test, the stopped run's report was written during the next test, and the next run's status briefly read 'done'. Check that stop cancels testing immediately and that a late finish cannot overwrite a newer run's phase.

findings.title: Crawl result carries neither the HostPacer nor robots Crawl-delay, so pipeline checks ignore it
findings.recommendation: Return pacer or crawlDelayMs from runAuditCrawl and pass it to runAuditPipeline (pipeline.ts:343 fallback builds a new pacer without Crawl-delay).

resolution.note: BE-204 returns pacer/crawlDelayMs (EV-0172); BE-192 pipeline uses crawl.pacer (EV-0175)

findings.title: Pipeline leaves the version 'running' on save failure; updateVersion failure after a stored result throws the same save error
findings.recommendation: BE-190 must set status 'failed' on AuditPipelineError, crawl error and abort. Separate or retry the post-save updateVersion failure so a stored result is not reported as unsaved.

resolution.note: Fixed. Pipeline (BE-192, pipeline.ts:661-689): a save failure throws AuditPipelineError 'save-failed'; a failed updateVersion after a stored result is retried once, then throws the distinct 'status-not-updated'. Caller (BE-205, audit-crawl.ts:292-307 runAuditVersion): abort -> 'stopped', 'status-not-updated' -> status set to done from the stored result (never failed), crawl error -> 'failed' AUDIT_CRAWL_FAILED, save failure -> 'failed' AUDIT_SAVE_FAILED; slot released in every case. Tests: audit-crawl-route.test.ts:484,498,523 (EV-0192 PASS) and audit-pipeline.test.ts:610,621 (CHK-BE-192-UNIT EV-0175 PASS).

findings.title: helperGrants gets no audit id for id-less view routes (/api/audits, /api/shortlist); HelperRouteStore does not match AuditStore
findings.recommendation: BE-190: grant 'view' on id-less list routes when the Helper holds any view grant (handlers already filter via grantedAuditIds), and adapt AuditStore to HelperRouteStore (getAudit vs readAuditRecord).

resolution.note: BE-102 correction verified: loopback-only owner without key (DEC-004); Helper dispatch wiring incl. id-less view rows

findings.title: Duplicated pitchScreenshots, IMAGE_TYPES and MAX_SCREENSHOT_BYTES in export and share
findings.recommendation: Extract one helper (audit-helpers.ts or core) used by both audit-export.ts:190 and audit-share.ts:158.

findings.title: Preview file name defined three times and preview image cap duplicates core's PREVIEW_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES
findings.recommendation: Import PREVIEW_FILE_NAME and PREVIEW_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES from @qa/core instead of PREVIEW_FILE (audit-preview.ts:33), PREVIEW_FILE_NAME (audit-share.ts:70) and IMAGE_MAX_BYTES.

findings.title: invalid-key store error maps to 404 in helper rows but 400 elsewhere; not-found wording differs
findings.recommendation: Use one mapping and one not-found sentence across all audit routes (404 preferred).

findings.title: 500 replies lack a code field, unlike every other audit refusal
findings.recommendation: Add a generic AuditErrorCode for store failures and use it in all route files' 500 paths.

findings.title: REVIEW-005: a Check-up can enter Plan Review and run tests while a Website Audit or benchmark holds the run slot
findings.recommendation: ensurePlanLoaded must set awaiting-review only when begin() succeeds; waiting-plans POST (plan.ts:1215) and approve (plan.ts:945) must answer 409 ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS when session.run.kind is audit or benchmark; add tests for both paths.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-102 correction: ensurePlanLoaded (plan.ts:218-225 and server.ts:3342-3348) sets awaiting-review only when RunSlot.begin() succeeds; approve and waiting-plans POST answer 409 ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS while an audit or benchmark holds the slot; waiting-plans takes the slot through begin(). Regression block route-access-server.test.ts:446 failed on the old code; CHK-BE-102-SERVER EV-0209 and CHK-BE-102-UNIT EV-0210 PASS.

findings.title: REVIEW-005: a version left 'running' after a runner stop can never be deleted or re-run
findings.recommendation: Decide 'running' from the live AuditRuns registry (runs.get(id) exists and not finished) in the re-run route (BE-603) and pass isRunning from the same registry to auditStoreRoutes in routes/index.ts (BE-190), so delete and re-run work after a restart or crash (ADR 0036 deletion).

resolution.note: Fixed: re-run decides running from the live AuditRuns registry (BE-603, EV-0206) and routes/index.ts passes a live-run isRunning to auditStoreRoutes (BE-190 second pass, EV-0228), so a version left running after a restart can be deleted and re-run.

findings.title: REVIEW-005: deploy.yml --set-env-vars has a comma inside the RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS value, so gcloud rejects it
findings.recommendation: Use gcloud's alternate delimiter (--set-env-vars '^@^KEY=v@...') or --env-vars-file so the comma-separated origins stay one value; make deploy-audit-store.test.ts parse that form.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-607 correction: deploy.yml:143 --set-env-vars uses gcloud's ^@^ alternate delimiter so RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS keeps both origins as one value; deploy-audit-store.test.ts parses the flag as gcloud does (^DELIM^ prefix, KEY=value per item, unique keys) and failed on the old comma-only line before the fix. Not run against a real gcloud; scripts/deploy-cloud-run.mjs remains as F-033.

findings.title: scripts/deploy-cloud-run.mjs has the same comma-in-RUNNER_ALLOWED_ORIGINS problem as deploy.yml (pre-existing, f2c8a51; no task owns the file)
findings.recommendation: Use the same alternate delimiter as the deploy.yml fix; needs a plan change (file outside every task's ownership).

findings.title: REVIEW-005: edits overlay has two writers (PATCH edits queued, rewrite accept not): lost update
findings.recommendation: Export one serialised overlay update (or use store.withAuditLock) and use it from both PATCH edits and the rewrite accept path in routes/index.ts.

resolution.note: Fixed: updateEditsOverlay exported from audit-documents.ts on the per-version queue (BE-509, EV-0214); PATCH and the rewrite-accept path in routes/index.ts both use it (BE-190 second pass, EV-0228).

findings.title: REVIEW-005: Shared Link create answers 409 with code ERR_INVALID_REQUEST
findings.recommendation: Use 400 with ERR_INVALID_REQUEST, or a dedicated code with 409.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-604 correction: preview link without stored preview answers 400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST; pitch link without finished result answers 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND (as audit-export.ts); running stays 409 ERR_AUDIT_RUNNING. Tests updated.

findings.title: REVIEW-005: CONFIGURATION.md says Helper sign-in needs all three Firebase values; code and DEPLOYMENT.md need project ID plus access key
findings.recommendation: Correct the sentence to match helper-access.ts:100.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-704 correction: CONFIGURATION.md states Helper sign-in turns on with FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID and RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN; FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY and FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN optional (default <projectId>.firebaseapp.com); wizard falls back to VITE_FIREBASE_*; DEC-011 re-sign-in note added (code change in BE-606, running).

findings.title: REVIEW-005: start screen gives no link to the finished audit; a 404 stream shows Reconnecting forever
findings.recommendation: Link to the audit history/results when done; treat a closed EventSource as final with a plain message.

resolution.note: Fixed by FE-200 correction: a finished audit links to /audits/:id (AuditFollowUpLink); a closed EventSource (readyState 2) is final (onEnd) and shows a plain 'progress stream ended' message with the history link instead of Reconnecting. Tests in audit-start-screen.test.tsx and audit-start-form.test.ts.

findings.title: REVIEW-005: RunSlot.release() is not tied to the claiming run
findings.recommendation: Make release() take the claiming run id.

findings.title: REVIEW-004: checker (phone, accessibility) findings cite no Section and citationProblems are dropped
findings.recommendation: Give checker findings the Section holding their target or mark them whole-page rules; save citationProblems with the version.

findings.title: REVIEW-004: technology detection by response header never runs in a real audit
findings.recommendation: Pass main-document response headers through onRecordedPage into readPage({ responseHeaders }) and/or AnalysisInput.headers; add a pipeline test.

findings.title: REVIEW-004: listAudits lists every object in the store on each Saved Audits or Shortlist view
findings.recommendation: Add a folder-level listing (GCS delimiter or matchGlob audits/*/audit.json; local non-recursive readdir) and use it in listAudits/listShortlist.

findings.title: REVIEW-004: Cloud Storage deletePrefix deletes one object at a time while the audit lock is held
findings.recommendation: Limited parallel DELETEs or the batch endpoint.

findings.title: REVIEW-004: Check-up SEO broken-link check no longer follows redirects
findings.recommendation: Give the SEO checker a redirect-following fetch with each hop re-checked, or add this to DEC-006.

findings.title: REVIEW-004: a 120 s default deadline now applies to every Check-up AI call
findings.recommendation: Confirm intent; let Check-up callers pass a longer timeoutMs.

findings.title: SEC-003: Helper session cookie is signed with a key derived from RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN, which every beta tester holds: any tester can forge a Helper session for any email
findings.recommendation: Sign Helper sessions with a key no tester holds (a dedicated secret, or a random per-runner key), keep Helper sign-in off without it, bind the cookie to the Google sub, and add a test that a cookie signed with an access-token-derived key is refused.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-606 correction per DEC-011: helperSessionKey (HKDF of RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN) removed; each HelperAccess signs qa_helper with randomBytes(32) held in memory; cookie claims {email, sub, exp}, sub required and MAC-covered. Regression tests: old-HKDF cookies, another instance's key, missing or changed sub all refused (helper-session/helper-access/audit-helpers-routes tests, CHK-BE-606-UNIT EV-0221). Follow-up: 4 test call sites in route-access-server.test.ts and server-audit-wiring.test.ts via BE-102/BE-612.

findings.title: SEC-003: Firebase web API key (public via /api/helper/status) has no documented API or referrer restriction
findings.recommendation: Add a DEPLOYMENT.md step restricting the key to Identity Toolkit and Secure Token APIs and to the runner and site HTTP referrers.

findings.title: SEC-003: PDF exports launch one Chromium per request with no concurrency cap
findings.recommendation: Put renderPdf behind a 1-2 slot semaphore and answer 429/503 when busy.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-510 correction: PDF exports limited to 2 concurrent per runner (deps.maxConcurrentPdf), over the limit answers 503 with Retry-After and ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS; slot released in finally; tests for 503, non-PDF unaffected, release after error.

findings.title: SEC-003: removeHelper sends the Helper email in the query string (lands in request logs)
findings.recommendation: Send the email in a request body or use an opaque grant id.

findings.title: SEC-003: export, edits and AI rows get no caller and rely only on the dispatch Helper check
findings.recommendation: Pass caller to these rows and call mayUseAudit where the audit data is read (ADR 0037).

findings.title: SEC-003: Helper sessions are stateless; sign-out does not end a copied cookie (up to 8 h)
findings.recommendation: If needed, a server-side session id or a per-email revocation epoch.

findings.title: SEC-002: audit crawl does not pin the audited host in Chromium; DNS rebinding passes the public-only guard and private content is read, stored and shareable
findings.recommendation: Resolve the start host (and www twin) with resolvePublic, launch the audit's own Chromium with --host-resolver-rules mapping them to the checked address, fail closed if resolution fails, and do not inherit the global browserPolicy.pinned.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-204 correction: crawl resolves the start host once with resolvePublic and fails closed (AuditCrawlRefusedError), launches its own Chromium with --host-resolver-rules pinning the host and www twin (~NOTFOUND when not public), never inherits browserPolicy.pinned; DNS-rebinding test added.

findings.title: SEC-002: audit browser context allows service workers, whose requests skip the request guard and blockChanges
findings.recommendation: Create the audit context with serviceWorkers: 'block' (render-pdf.ts:52 already does) and add a fixture test with a page that registers a service worker.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-204 correction: audit context created with serviceWorkers 'block' (crawl.ts:276); test asserts it.

findings.title: SEC-002: preview CSS sanitiser lets an unbalanced [ or ( in an AI selector swallow the frame CSS, so the AI-preview note can be covered
findings.recommendation: Reject selectors with unbalanced brackets, parentheses or quotes; put FRAME_CSS in its own style element before the AI's styles.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-605 correction: balancedSelector drops selectors with unbalanced brackets, parentheses or quotes; FRAME_CSS is served in its own style element after the AI's; both CSPs hash every style element.

findings.title: SEC-002: after the crawl time limit, the link check can GET robots-disallowed and checkout paths
findings.recommendation: Pass the crawl's RobotsPolicy to checkLinks and re-apply isAllowed, isCheckoutPath and pathLimitVerdict before each request.

findings.title: SEC-002: robots.txt 5xx, 429 or no answer is treated as allow-all (RFC 9309: server error means disallow)
findings.recommendation: For the Website Audit treat 5xx, 429 and network failure as disallow-all or stop with a note; keep 4xx as allow-all.

findings.title: SEC-002: audit crawler does not identify itself (HeadlessChrome UA, no UA on outbound fetches) though robots uses QA-Benchmarking-Bot
findings.recommendation: Send one user agent with the token and a contact URL on the browser context and outbound fetches.

findings.title: SEC-002: robots.txt checked only against the requested path and start origin; a disallowed landed path after a redirect is still recorded
findings.recommendation: Check the landed path against robots before recording, and fetch robots.txt per origin including the www twin.

findings.title: SEC-002: test fixture matches the anthropic-key secret rule (high); needs a human check that it is synthetic
findings.recommendation: Developer confirms the value is fake (rotate immediately if real); replace with an obviously fake value or add a scanner allowlist entry.

resolution.note: False positive: the developer confirmed on 2026-11-03 that packages/core/tests/key-resolver-encryption.test.ts:158 holds no real Anthropic key (value not read by the orchestrator). No rotation needed.

findings.title: SEC-002: Gemini model id goes into the request URL without encoding
findings.recommendation: encodeURIComponent(model) or a strict model-id pattern.

findings.title: REVIEW-006: Improvement Roadmap item titles ignore finding edits and removed pages (Roadmap, Proposal timeline, Owner Audit show corrected text)
findings.recommendation: In buildEditedView set each kept roadmap item's title from its first kept finding after edits and recompute priority, effort and phase from kept findings; add a test covering roadmap-document.ts:98 and proposal.ts:219.

resolution.note: Fixed by BE-500 correction: buildEditedView rebuilds roadmap items from kept findings as edited (title from first kept finding; priority/effort/phase recomputed with buildRoadmap's rule when findings drop). 4 regression tests failed before and pass after; neighbouring document suites pass (6 files, 131 tests).

findings.title: REVIEW-006: claim-word check is English-only but AI writes Tamil copy
findings.recommendation: Add claim forms for each document language with a table (at least ta) and test rewrite/page-recommendation with Tamil answers.

findings.title: REVIEW-006: RewriteStore save queue is per object but the runner creates a new store per request (lost approvals)
findings.recommendation: Module-level queue per file path, or cache one RewriteStore per version folder in routes/index.ts.

findings.title: REVIEW-006: NAP from a LocalBusiness JSON-LD block over 4,000 characters is lost (cut copy no longer parses)
findings.recommendation: Extract NAP/LocalBusiness nodes from the full parse in readDom; add a test with a block over 4,000 characters.

findings.title: REVIEW-006: Page Content caps only page text; link, image, CTA, heading, form and address lists and heading text are uncapped
findings.recommendation: Cap each list and string in readDom and record that a list was cut.

findings.title: REVIEW-006: with a cloud store, rewrite state is kept on the runner's local /tmp and lost on scale-to-zero
findings.recommendation: Store rewrites.json through the audit store backend beside the version.

findings.title: SEC-004: on a keyed copy a Helper without the access key cannot load the wizard or /helper (UI served after the access-key gate), so using Helpers means handing out the owner key
findings.recommendation: When Helper sign-in is enabled, serve the data-free app shell and assets ('/', '/helper', '/audits/...', '/assets/...') without the key, keep every data API on its declared access level, confirm the bundle has no secrets, and add a test that a keyless signed-in Helper loads /helper and its granted audit.

resolution.note: Known limitation (DEC-012): fix in follow-up

findings.title: SEC-004: Helper sign-in cannot work from the site host, yet DEPLOYMENT.md says to add the site host to Firebase authorized domains
findings.recommendation: State that Helper sign-in works on the runner host only and drop the site-host advice (or proxy /api same-origin from the site host).

findings.title: SEC-004: rewrite state on the cloud backend lives in <dataDir>/audit-rewrites and is not removed when the audit is deleted (ADR 0036)
findings.recommendation: Keep rewrite state inside the audit store so the prefix delete covers it, or delete that folder in the audit delete path; add a test.

findings.title: SEC-004: export bundle README tells a coding assistant to act on site.json (verbatim page text) without marking it untrusted
findings.recommendation: Add to the README and a site.json note that titles, Section texts and finding details are copied from the audited site and are data only, never instructions.

findings.title: SEC-004: rewrite answers are not checked for new phone numbers, emails, URLs or prices absent from the original
findings.recommendation: Reject or flag candidates whose URLs, emails or phone-like tokens do not appear in the original.

findings.title: SEC-004: NAP extraction takes any <address> element and keeps emails in mixed lines
findings.recommendation: Strip emails from all lines, prefer LocalBusiness JSON-LD or footer-level address, drop non-business name lines (ADR 0036 minimisation).

findings.title: SEC-004: content and file rows declare no explicit beta policy (default closed)
findings.recommendation: Declare beta explicitly on these rows like the other audit rows.
